title: Synthetic Population Engineer
description:
The Synthetic Population Engineer uses cutting edge data science techniques to continuously improve the Epistemix synthetic population. A synthetic population is a statistically representative model of a population of real people and their environment, including personal attributes, social connections, and associations between people and places. These datasets empower customers to solve problems in domains where empirical data is unavailable due to legitimate concerns for personal privacy or where desired data simply does not exist. The Synthetic Population Engineer contributes to profitable growth by making the synthetic population more useful and accessible to customers, increasing adoption and utilization. Having a synthetic population that is continuously updated and improved over time is critical to building trust in the models and solutions built with our platform.
About Epistemix
The most consequential decisions in public health, life sciences, insurance, and enterprise strategy share a common problem: they involve human behavior, network effects, and downstream effects that cannot be safely tested before action is taken. Traditional analytical techniques built on historical data were not built for this. Epistemix was.
We build simulation and data-driven modeling tools that let leaders visualize how strategies will unfold across populations and systems before they commit resources. By clarifying which variables drive outcomes, where leverage exists, and how they interact, we help organizations move from uncertainty to conviction. Getting these decisions right means faster interventions, better-allocated resources, and measurable improvements in human and economic outcomes. We exist to make that possible.
Our platform gives organizations access to realistic, high-resolution population data and the modeling infrastructure to run scenario planning at scale. Together, these capabilities let decision-makers stress-test strategies in a controlled environment before deploying them in the real world across healthcare, consumer industries, insurance, and government. We are approaching our Series B and actively building the team that will define what comes next.
Responsibilities

• Identify and evaluate empirical datasets and use them to enrich the synthetic population to enable new use cases, including through adding new individual attributes and detailed social networks.

• Utilize simulation techniques, including ABMs, to project future demographic trends.

• Improve the geographical plausibility of synthetic environments, ensuring realistic placement of homes, workplaces, schools, and other points of interest (e.g., along roads, close to real world population centers).

• Expand the geographical region covered by the Epistemix synthetic population, with the goal of creating a fully integrated and consistent representation of the global population.

• Create visualizations for marketing and productizing synthetic populations.

• Develop innovative methods for supporting external users in augmenting Epistemix synthetic populations with their own proprietary data.

• Work with external vendors and marketplaces to expand the ecosystem of data providers that can be integrated with the synthetic population.

• Support the synthetic populations team in engaging with customer success, professional services, and engineering teams to understand project specific synthetic population requirements.

Qualifications

•
Proficient experience in:

• Using Python for data science applications.

• Working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL (additional database management experience preferred).

• Working with geospatial data.

• Working with simulation or machine learning models.

• Demonstrate empathy for users and decision makers by explaining how the synthetic population was created (e.g., which data sources and models were used) in an accessible way for all.

• Possessing the passion to build the standard for synthetic populations

About India Market Entry (IME):

India Market Entry (IME) is a boutique market-entry consultancy helping international education companies establish and scale in India. Headquartered in Faridabad, we operate across 9 Indian cities with a 68-member team, 35+ global education clients, and a 150+ reseller network. Our clients include Save My Exams, Express Publishing, World Book, Hamilton House, Mathspace, EdAlive, and more.We are expanding our marketing team with new and Lead-generation Specialist (LGS) roles focused on driving high-quality lead qualification and sales conversions.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Indian D2C education is large, fragmented, and unit-economics-fragile. Many D2C brands hit the same wall around Series A - CAC too high, retention choppy, next growth chapter requires institutional channel or bundling. That inflection point is your hunting ground. You speak with founders, growth heads, and BD heads at Indian D2C edtechs (subscription apps, parent-tutor marketplaces, AI-tutor brands), plus partnership heads at banks, NBFCs, and telcos exploring education bundles. You qualify their B2B-readiness, identify the right IME engagement pathway (Research / Decide / Validate / Scale) or portfolio fit, and hand off to the LSM team. These are peer conversations with founders - not vendor pitches.

Responsibilities:

• Build and maintain the canonical Indian D2C education master list (~250 brands) plus the bank/NBFC/telco partnership list (~50 counterparties).

• Run multi-touch outbound sequences (LinkedIn + email primary, WhatsApp once warm) to founders, growth heads, and BD heads.

• Reach 50-80 founder / growth-head conversations per month.

• Apply the D2C-variant of the qualifying questionnaire - D2C unit economics, B2B intent, channel readiness, product portability into school/edupreneur context.

• Identify D2C brands at the 'B2B pivot' inflection point - these are highest-conversion prospects.

• Recommend an engagement pathway per qualified prospect - IME Research, Decide, Validate, or Scale, or portfolio-fit partnership.

• Track and act on funding signals - every Series A announcement in Indian edtech is a 7-day follow-up window.

• Coordinate event-driven follow-ups around YourStory TechSparks, EdTech Review summits, NASSCOM Product Conclave.

Requirements
Skills Required:

• 3-5 years of B2B inside sales / BD with D2C, consumer-tech, or startup exposure.

• Comfort speaking with Indian D2C founders in peer register - this is not a vendor pitch.

• Working knowledge of the Indian D2C education landscape and the D2C unit-economics vocabulary (CAC, LTV, payback, churn, MAU, DAU).

• Strong written-English skills for LinkedIn DMs and founder-style emails.

• Pattern-recognition for pivot-point signals - funding + hiring + product-pivot together signals readiness.

• Prior experience inside an Indian D2C edtech or consumer-tech startup.

• Awareness of recent Indian edtech funding, M&A, and down-round activity.

• Working familiarity with the IME 4-tier productised architecture (IME Research / Decide / Validate / Scale).

Benefits
Benefits Offered:

• Competitive fixed plus performance-linked incentive, paid monthly.

• Direct relationships with the next wave of Indian D2C edtech founders.

• Cohort learning with extended 90-day ramp.

• Path to Senior ISM, Cohort Lead, or D2C-vertical LSM / strategy roles.

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, and more countries soon, love running on Tebi.

We're looking for an ambitious Sales Development Representative to join our team. You’ll be at the heart of our growth engine - managing the beginning of our sales cycle, directly driving our business and revenue growth by bringing in new customers.

In this role, you’ll blend your people and communication skills with passion to make hospitality businesses more smooth in their operations. Our sales are not your typical SaaS or office sales. We meet our customers where they operate. In this role you will:

- Communicate our value and mission to our prospective partners, build trusted relationships with the hospitality network in the region.

What You’ll Need

- 0-1 years of experience in Sales, Sales Operations or Customer-facing roles ideally within SaaS/ Tech/ Hospitality or Startup space.

- Passion for the hospitality industry and customer-facing activities is a strong plus.

- Willingness to roll up your sleeves and “Leave your ego at the door” mentality

- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced startup environment.

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with customers and internal stakeholders.

- Entrepreneurial mindset: you thrive in fast-moving environments, love building from scratch, and bias toward action.

- The ideal candidate will be fluent in English and Italian

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

- Start-up Equity

- Competitive Salary

- Flexible time-off

- Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

title: Senior Product Manager, Shared Hosting
description:
Who We Are
At Bluehost, we believe all small businesses deserve the opportunity to succeed online. Our mission is to give small businesses the confidence to think big. We're the all-in-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support.
Shared hosting is the foundation of our business. It is where most of our customers begin, where millions of small businesses and creators keep their websites running every day, and where the durability of our relationship with them is decided. This is not a greenfield product - it is a large, mature, revenue-critical platform with real customers, real constraints, and enormous leverage in every point of retention we earn back.
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the strategy and roadmap for our shared hosting platform, with a clear mandate: make the experience after purchase so good that customers stay.
Most of the hosting industry competes on the first 60 seconds - the price on the landing page. We intend to win on everything that happens afterward: how quickly a customer gets a working site, how rarely they need to contact support, how confidently they understand what they are paying for, and whether they renew. You will own that journey end to end, and you will be measured on retention, not on shipped features.
This is a role for a product manager who is energized rather than intimidated by a large legacy platform, who reads support transcripts for fun, and who understands that in a high-volume, low-ARPU business, a one-point improvement in renewal rate is worth more than most new products.
What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark.
Own the strategy and roadmap

• Define and own the multi-quarter vision, strategy, and roadmap for the shared hosting platform across brands, and get real alignment on it from engineering through executive leadership.

• Make explicit, defensible prioritization calls about where we invest - and where we deliberately do not - in a portfolio with more legitimate demands than capacity.

• Build the business cases that unlock investment: sizing, cohort impact modeling, and a credible view of payback.

Own retention as a product problem

•
Diagnose churn properly. Separate first-term churn from renewal-term churn, voluntary from involuntary, price-driven from experience-driven - then build a roadmap that attacks the largest addressable causes rather than the loudest ones.

•
Fix the renewal moment. Introductory-to-renewal price transitions are the single largest churn event in this industry. Partner with pricing, billing, and lifecycle marketing to make renewal transparent, well-timed, and defensible on value rather than surprising.

•
Recover involuntary churn. Own the product surface of failed payments, expiring cards, dunning, and reactivation - some of the highest-ROI work available on a subscription base this size.

•
Reduce refund and cancellation rate inside the money-back guarantee window by finding and removing the specific early-life failures that cause it.

Own the customer experience end to end

•
Compress time-to-first-published-site. Own provisioning, onboarding, domain connection, and the first-session experience. Every day between purchase and a live site is a day of churn risk.

•
Modernize the control panel experience. Shape the customer-facing evolution of our hosting management experience - including the migration path off cPanel-era tooling - with usability and continuity for existing customers as first-order constraints, not afterthoughts.

•
Attack support contact drivers. Partner with Customer Care to identify the top reasons customers contact us - DNS and domain confusion, email deliverability, performance complaints, malware remediation, billing questions, migration failures - and convert contact-rate reduction into a funded product roadmap. Lower contact rate and higher satisfaction are the same work done well.

The Product Builder, Merchant Portal is a hands-on, builder-first role. This person will be focused on defining, designing, and prototyping features for Payments Hub, North’s merchant portal covering Transactions, Reporting, Disputes, Online Ordering/Store, Business Management, and Integrations for all merchants in the North portfolio.

This role bridges product strategy and execution by rapidly validating concepts, creating precise technical specifications, and building proof-of-concept features in sandbox environments without waiting for traditional design or full engineering cycles. By pairing deep technical fundamentals and AI tools with direct merchant discovery, the Product Builder dramatically accelerates product velocity to keep North competitive in the evolving payment processing landscape.

What You’ll Do:

• Define, design, and build end-to-end proof-of-concept features, interactive prototypes, and technical sandboxes for desktop, iOS, Android, and hardware (terminals/kiosks).

• Leverage modern LLM APIs and AI coding agents to accelerate product discovery, code generation, and functional prototyping.

• Bachelor’s Degree (BA or BS) or equivalent experience

• 1-2 years of experience with AI tools.

• Proven experience working with Agile software development teams.

• Strong proficiency with Jira and modern product management software.

• Product Owner Certification (CSPO, etc.) preferred.

• Payments or fintech industry experience is highly preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

• Strong technical fundamentals with proficiency in SQL, JavaScript, and REST/web APIs.

• Hands-on native or cross-platform iOS and Android mobile development experience.

• Familiar with payment hardware ecosystems, including card readers, POS terminals, and kiosks.

• High fluency with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and AI-assisted coding agents.

• Deep user empathy combined with a strong bias for action and tangible proof over slides/presentations.

• Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage

• Flexible Paid Time Off

• 401(k) + Match

• Mental Health Support & Well-Being Program

• Paid Maternity & Paternity Leave

• Education Assistance

About the Role
The Salesforce Administrator owns and optimizes our Salesforce platform - a mature, heavily automated environment spanning Sales Cloud and Service Cloud. System Administration & Security

• Serve as the primary system administrator for Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.

• Manage user lifecycle, roles, profiles, permission sets, field-level security, and sharing rules.

• Support end users with troubleshooting, training, and documentation to drive adoption across departments.

Automation & Process Modernization

• Design, build, and maintain complex declarative automation using Salesforce Flow (record-triggered, screen, scheduled, and HTTP callout flows).

• Audit, rationalize, and retire legacy Workflow Rules and Process Builders into clean, maintainable Flows.

• Build and maintain reports and dashboards supporting pipeline, subscription-revenue metrics ( MRR, ARR, churn ), and operational decision-making.

• Ensure data hygiene through validation rules, deduplication, and regular audits (e.g., lead-source completeness, duplicate resolution).

AI & Innovation

• Leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT) to accelerate Flow design, formula building, metadata analysis, documentation, and troubleshooting.

Analytics: Strong proficiency with custom report types, bucket fields, and dashboards; comfort with SaaS metrics (MRR/ARR/churn) preferred.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Financial Systems Lead
description:
About Teamshares
Teamshares is a technology-enabled acquirer of small and midsize businesses. We buy companies with $0.5 million to $5 million in EBITDA, integrate them with our platform, and help employees become owners. Founded in 2019, we operate 90+ subsidiaries with approximately $490 million in consolidated revenue across 40+ industries and 30 states.
The Role
We're looking for a Financial Systems Lead to own the financial-systems strategy and execution across our network of companies. You'll design and implement ERP solutions, evaluate financial-systems tools and platforms, advise leadership on technology investments, and ensure each company has the systems and processes to manage its own finances effectively.
This is an individual contributor role focused on strategy, design, and hands-on execution. You'll work directly with company finance teams and implementation partners, troubleshoot technical problems, establish best practices, and build the financial-systems foundation that enables our companies to operate independently.
You'll have significant influence over how we approach financial systems across the network. As we grow, you'll build and lead a small team. We're looking for someone who can handle the immediate hands-on work while growing into broader leadership of this function.
About two-thirds of our network uses QuickBooks Online. We have several companies on NetSuite and others on industry-specific platforms. You'll think strategically about the entire financial-systems landscape, not just one platform. You'll evaluate payment processors, sales tax software, accounting automation, and specialized tools as the need arises. 
Responsibilities
Financial-Systems Strategy & Platform Selection: Help leadership evaluate and decide which financial platforms are right for which companies. Make recommendations on QuickBooks Online vs. NetSuite vs. industry-specific ERPs. Build a long-term vision for standardization across the network. Evaluate new tools and technologies as opportunities arise.
Implementation Leadership & Design: Work with implementation partners and company finance teams to design and execute ERP transitions. Make recommendations on configuration vs. customization vs. process change. Ensure implementations deliver real business value and companies can operate independently.
Financial-Systems Standards & Governance: Establish best practices and standards for financial systems across the network. Define how we handle common financial scenarios: multi-subsidiary accounting, intercompany transactions, reporting structures, tax compliance. Document these approaches so they scale.
Vendor & Partner Collaboration: Work as a peer with implementation consultants and technology vendors. Evaluate their recommendations and proposals. Challenge over-engineered or unnecessary solutions. Support leadership with technical assessment of partners and vendors.
Problem-Solving & Technical Leadership: When companies encounter financial-systems challenges, you're the escalation point. Diagnose problems, work with partners and vendors to find solutions, and make recommendations. Roll up your sleeves on troubleshooting and hands-on work as needed.
What We're Looking For
7-12 years of experience in ERP implementations, financial-systems leadership, enterprise accounting, or related fields.
Deep hands-on knowledge of Netsuite and practical experience with other financial-systems tools.
Strong judgment about financial-systems architecture. You can evaluate trade-offs between different platforms, vendors, and approaches. You make decisions based on what the business actually needs.
Experience evaluating and advising on technology vendors and solutions. You can assess whether a vendor's proposal is sound and spot over-engineering.
Comfortable working with ambiguity and in growing organizations. You're not constrained by perfect upfront planning and can adapt as circumstances change.
Able to communicate clearly with different audi

CLEAResult ’s Strategic Energy Management (SEM) team is growing, and we’re looking for a Senior SEM Coach to guide energy teams at large commercial, institutional and industrial facilities through continuous improvement. Your main role is to coach plant and facility staff to find, evaluate and implement energy savings. • Build client trust and show the value of SEM so participants stay engaged and savings keep growing.

• Mentor junior coaches and help refine SEM tools and materials.

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field (Master’s preferred).

• Proven project management skills, including managing multiple projects at once.

• Proficiency in Excel (formulas, charting, data interpretation), Word (styles, cross-referencing, professional layout) and PowerPoint (slide masters, consistent branding, clear and engaging design).

Preferred

title: Ingénieur en Intégration de Composants Haute Tension (Full Remote)(H/F/X)
description:
Aperçu de l’entreprise
TMC est un cabinet de conseil de premier plan spécialisé dans la fourniture de connaissances spécialisées en physique, logiciel, nanotechnologie et science des données. Nous permettons aux entreprises d’innover et de garder une longueur d’avance sur le marché concurrentiel en tirant parti des technologies de pointe et des progrès scientifiques.
Titre du poste
Ingénieur en Intégration de Composants Haute Tension (H/F/X)
Localisation
Full Remote, Europe
Nous recherchons un ingénieur spécialisé dans l'intégration de composants haute tension pour rejoindre notre équipe. Votre rôle consistera à développer et à intégrer des composants électriques de haute tension dans nos produits, en assurant leur conformité aux normes et spécifications techniques.
En tant qu'ingénieur en intégration de composants haute tension, vous serez responsable des tâches suivantes :

• Créer une fiche produit pour les nouveaux composants haute tension (HV) : Il s'agit de créer une documentation décrivant les spécifications, les caractéristiques et d'autres informations pertinentes sur les composants haute tension à intégrer.

• Réaliser des examens/révisions techniques : Effectuer des examens techniques approfondis pour s'assurer que l'intégration des composants haute tension répond à toutes les normes, exigences et règles de sécurité nécessaires.

• Élaborer des lignes directrices pour l'installation : Élaborer des lignes directrices détaillées pour l'installation de chaque composant haute tension, couvrant à la fois les interfaces mécaniques et électriques. En outre, créer des documents d'interface fonctionnelle pour garantir une intégration transparente dans l'architecture fonctionnelle globale.

• Suivi des activités fournisseurs : Suivre les activités des fournisseurs, y compris leurs plans de développement, leurs plans de validation de la conception et tous les problèmes qui se posent, ainsi que les plans d'action correspondants pour les résoudre.

• Diffusion de la documentation : Vous serez responsable de la diffusion de la documentation 3D des composants aux parties concernées.

• Créer des spécifications de dessin en 2D : Générer des spécifications de dessin 2D détaillées qui soulignent les dimensions précises, les tolérances et les autres spécifications nécessaires à la fabrication et à l'assemblage.

• Effectuer une analyse des modes de défaillance et de leurs effets (DFMEA) : Réaliser l'AMDE pour identifier et atténuer les modes de défaillance potentiels et leurs effets sur la conception et la fonctionnalité des composants haute tension.

• Soutien aux activités de sign-off et de PEA (Product Engineering Authorization) : Vous apporterez un soutien technique aux activités de sign-off et de PEA , assurer toutes les approbations nécessaires avant et/ou après implémentation (intégration)

En accomplissant ces tâches, vous garantirez l'intégration réussie des composants haute tension dans les projets et les lignes de produits spécifiés, tout en accordant la priorité à la sécurité, à la fonctionnalité et à la conformité aux normes et réglementations en vigueur.
Compétences requises :

• Diplôme d'ingénieur en électrotechnique, génie électrique ou domaine similaire.

• Bonne compréhension des concepts de haute tension et des normes associées.

• Expérience dans le développement et l'intégration de composants électriques.

• Compétences en analyse de risques (DFMEA).

• Capacité à travailler en équipe et à communiquer efficacement.

• Rigueur et souci du détail.

Renseignements supplémentaires
Pour plus de détails sur le rôle, les responsabilités et les qualifications, les candidats intéressés sont invités à visiter la page carrières TMC. Nous sommes un employeur équitable et valorisons la diversité au sein de notre entreprise.

title: Developer Relations Manager – Data Processing and Databases
description:
NVIDIA is building GPU acceleration for the analytical data processing ecosystem: the query engines, data platforms, and processing frameworks that the world runs its analytics on. Making that real means embedding an acceleration layer inside engines we do not own. Each of those engines has its own optimizer, scheduler, memory model, and exchange, and each one draws the line between "adopt your component" and "keep mine" in a different place. Nobody has settled what that integration surface should look like. That is the problem this role owns. We are looking for someone with genuine depth in how analytical data systems are built: query planning and processing, columnar and vectorized processing, storage formats, or the internals of a SQL engine.
You will work with the maintainers, architects, and engineering leaders behind these systems, in public where the project is open and directly where it is not, on how acceleration lands in what they ship. You will produce the benchmark evidence that shows whether it worked, and turn what you learn into concrete requirements for NVIDIA 's roadmap. This is a developer relations role rather than an engineering role because the leverage is breadth. An engineer improves one engine. This role shapes how acceleration lands across the ecosystem and influences which parts of it get there first.
What You'll Be Doing:

• Build and deepen technical expertise in analytical data processing, including query execution and optimization, columnar and vectorized processing, and distributed execution. Serve as a technical advocate and trusted resource for the developers building and operating these systems, working with cross-functional partners to drive adoption of NVIDIA technologies such as Sirius, cuCascade, RAPIDS, cuDF, nvCOMP, and CUDA-X Data Processing.

• Demonstrate and integrate NVIDIA 's data processing stack (libraries, SDKs, and tools) into real query engines and OLAP databases, carrying the work from prototype through to a functioning, measured integration across cloud, hybrid, and on-prem deployments.

• Support developers, projects, and partners through onboarding and integration by providing working reference implementations, integration guides, and direct hands-on engineering help, so that a first integration produces a real accelerated query path rather than a demo.

• Track the analytical data processing ecosystem: new engines, execution models, storage formats, and competing approaches to acceleration. Share what you learn with NVIDIA engineering, product, marketing, and the worldwide field organization to shape adoption strategy.

• Collaborate with engine architects and NVIDIA engineering to resolve integration problems, establish best-practice patterns, and feed concrete technical requirements back to NVIDIA product teams.

• Define the integration surface between NVIDIA 's GPU data processing libraries and third-party query engines: where the plan handoff occurs, how execution and memory ownership are divided, and which of a partner's differentiating components remain in place alongside ours. Specify the APIs NVIDIA must expose to make that possible, and carry the patterns that work forward from one integration to the next.

• Own the benchmark evidence for GPU-accelerated analytics. Design and run TPC-H, TPC-DS, and ClickBench measurements against the strongest available CPU baselines, separate cold and warm behavior, and publish results that hold up to outside scrutiny. Use those results to establish where the acceleration case is proven, where it is not yet, and what has to change.

• Own the acceleration roadmap jointly with the projects and partners you work with: what gets built, in what order, and which technical bets are worth making. Earn that standing where the work happens, through upstream contribution and public design review in open source, and through joint architecture and roadmap planning with partner engineering leadership.

We're looking for a GTM Engineering Manager to lead our team of GTM engineers. Our Revenue Operations team works like a product and engineering org: planners define what marketing, sales, and customer success need, and GTM engineers design and build it with LLMs, workflow tools, and code. You'll own how that team works: its standards, its infrastructure, and the growth of the people on it. You'll stay hands-on, building the systems that make the whole team faster.

What you'll do

- Manage and develop a team of GTM engineers across marketing, sales, and platform work. Hire the next ones.

- Set the team's engineering practices: version control, review, documentation, and ownership for every workflow, agent, and integration in production.

- Build the team's own infrastructure, including the agents and tooling that keep work assigned, tracked, and current.

- Partner with GTM planners on the roadmap: bring the build-side view on what's feasible and how to sequence it, and put the right builder on the right project.

- Own relationships with the technical vendors the team builds on, such as Cargo.

What you'll bring

- 7+ years across RevOps, GTM engineering, marketing or sales ops engineering, or internal tools, with real hands-on building.

- 2+ years managing builders or technical roles, with people you've grown into stronger roles.

- You're a capable builder yourself: AI agents, workflow tools (Cargo, Clay, n8n, Zapier, or similar), APIs, webhooks, and Git.

- Engineering-manager instincts: you've set up review, documentation, and rollback practices on systems other people depend on.

- Fluency across the GTM funnel: marketing, sales, and customer success.

- Strong written communication. We're a documentation-first culture.

- Autonomous and self-directed. Tremendous is not a great fit for people who default to waiting for instructions.

description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne , c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable . Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain .
Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.
L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École.
Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques.
Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.
Vous rêvez d’une industrie propre, efficace et durable ? Le centre SPIN en fait sa priorité.
Énergie, environnement, procédés industriels… on y conçoit des systèmes pour produire mieux, avec moins.
L’objectif ? Limiter l’impact environnemental, réduire la consommation énergétique et booster l’efficacité.
🔧 Dans un monde en pleine mutation, nos équipes déploient leur créativité scientifique pour accompagner l’ industrie du futur.
Et vous, prêt·e à innover à nos côtés ?

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que stagiaire de Master 2, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions de formation, recherche et innovation, au sein du Laboratoire Georges Friedel (LGF, UMR CNRS 5307), Centre SPIN. Dans ce laboratoire, vous conjuguez passion scientifique et impact sociétal. Le LGF est une unité mixte de recherche CNRS et Mines Saint-Étienne. Il étudie la structure, les propriétés et la réactivité des matériaux, des poudres aux procédés énergétiques. Sa force : relier ce qui se passe à l’échelle du cristal à la performance d’un procédé.
Le stockage d’énergie thermochimique stocke la chaleur sous forme d’énergie chimique, grâce à des réactions solide-gaz réversibles. Les hydrates de sels inorganiques absorbent de la chaleur lors de leur déshydratation et la restituent lors de leur réhydratation, ce qui en fait des matériaux candidats pour le stockage de chaleur. Leur performance en cyclage dépend des structures cristallines traversées entre les états d’hydratation, dont le volume de maille et la symétrie peuvent différer fortement.
Les caractérisations ex situ, avant et après réaction, ne donnent accès qu’aux états extrêmes, pas au chemin de transformation. Ce stage suivra la transformation in situ afin d’identifier quelles phases apparaissent, dans quel ordre et avec quelle cinétique, et de comprendre pourquoi la réhydratation peut rester incomplète. Les hydrates de SrBr₂ servent de système modèle ; l’approche s’étend à d’autres hydrates de sels et à d’autres réactions gaz-solide.
• Vous réalisez une revue de la littérature sur les hydrates de sels pour le stockage thermochimique.
• Vous menez des cycles de déshydratation/réhydratation suivis par diffraction des rayons X in situ, sous température et humidité contrôlées.
• Vous quantifiez les fractions de phases par affinement de Rietveld (TOPAS, GSAS-II).
• Vous reliez structure et performance (fraction récupérée, vitesse de réaction, stabilité en cyclage).

Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay makes millions of dynamic, interconnected decisions across its network every day, and each one shapes the experience of the thousands of couriers who work with us. Knowing what any one of those decisions actually did is hard: couriers interfere with each other, effects vary from person to person, and the outcomes that matter compound over time.

Science at Relay is the brain of the operation: machine learning, operational research, recommender systems, causal inference, location intelligence and experimentation, working together to decide how every parcel gets delivered. You'll lead causal inference at Relay from the start.

CAUSAL INFERENCE HIGHLIGHTS

- A live, two-sided marketplace to experiment in, with every decision logged across millions of parcels.

- Interference between couriers, heterogeneous effects and long-term outcomes are the norm here, not the exception.

- Four marketplaces, each with its own app and its own economics.

- Your insights and models feed straight into Relay's network-wide optimisation.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Staff Applied Scientist at Relay, you'll:

- Set the standard for causal inference at Relay.

- Measure how our decisions affect each courier, today and over time.

- Shape how Relay experiments across a live, two-sided marketplace.

- Adapt advanced techniques across causal inference, statistics and machine learning to Relay's problems, and see them through to production.

- Partner with Operational Research to embed your insights and models into Relay's network-wide optimisation, and help build our research culture and voice in the tech community.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO…

- Bring deep expertise in causal inference, experimentation and machine learning, whether from a PhD, publications, or years at the frontier in industry.

- Come from statistics, an experimental science such as biology or psychology, or quantitative research.

- Have applied advanced techniques to real marketplaces or products, and owned the outcome.

- Think in mechanisms, and let evidence guide decisions.

- Are energised by open, interconnected problems, and know how to find the signal.

- Collaborate generously, and explain complex ideas simply.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

- Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

- All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

title: Korean Speaking Rust Coding Evaluation Specialist
description:
Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English. Your language skills and technical background decide where you fit.
About the project
Welo Data is helping evaluate how well AI coding agents perform when the instructions they receive are written in languages other than English. Agents are given a real software engineering task in a code repository, and automated tests check whether they solved it. The code, repositories and tests stay exactly as they are. Only the human-written instructions change language, so the quality of every instruction directly affects the result.
About the roles
There are two roles on this project. We place you in one of them based on your experience & skillsets.

• Translator: translate English software engineering task briefs into the target language. You keep every requirement, constraint and success condition, and you leave commands, file paths, API names, code and test conditions exactly as written in English. This role suits people with a stronger technical background, and translation experience is a plus.

• Reviewer: compare each translation with the English source, check that nothing is missing, added or changed in meaning, correct errors, and log each correction by error type. This role suits people with strong translation, editing or review experience and enough technical familiarity to read code context.

Who we are looking for

• Native or near-native writing in the target language, and strong reading ability in English.

• Either professional experience in translation, editing, review or technical writing, or a software background combined with excellent writing in the target language

• Comfort reading technical text. Coding experience is a strong plus for the translation role and helpful for the review role.

• Close attention to detail. In this project, a dropped clause can make a task fail.

Project at a glance

• Project duration: one week since the mid of November

• Languages: Korean

• Project time commitment: 6 hours per person

• Project compensation: US$65 - US$81 per hour

• Work location: fully remote

How selection works (major steps)

• Screening questions: about 2 minutes. They cover your language background, translation and review experience, which programming languages you know and how well, and your availability.

• Language test: short exercises in the target language.

• Programming skills assessment: you will be invited to another opportunity, in the programming language you know best (Rust, Go, Python, or TypeScript / JavaScript). It confirms your technical level and places you in a language track.

• Financial Onboarding & Role placement: complete the financial onboarding with Welo Data. In the meanwhile, you will be informed about the decision whether you are placed in the initial translation role or the review role.

• Production: once you finish all steps above, our project team will contact you for production.

THE ROLE

You’ll act as a trusted advisor to managers and employees, providing practical guidance and support across employee relations, performance management, manager coaching and the wider employee lifecycle. Combining hands-on HR expertise with a solutions-focused approach, you’ll help managers navigate complex people matters confidently, ensure consistent and compliant People practices across our global teams, and drive continuous improvement through data, technology and automation as Radiant continues to scale.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Act as the day-to-day point of contact for employees and managers on HR questions across the full employee lifecycle: onboarding, policy interpretation, benefits, and performance management.

- Managing employee relations, providing expert support and recommending appropriate actions to address queries or problems. Proactively reviewing data to spot employee relations trends and suggest solutions, coaching Managers to tackle issues early on.

- Serve as the local first line of defense for compliance, ensuring strict adherence to UK labor laws, employment standards, site-specific contracts, and safety protocols.

- Help coordinate and run core HR cycles: performance reviews, compensation planning, and engagement surveys, for the London office.

- Draft, review and interpret employment contracts, variations and restrictive covenants.

- Own the review and update of people policies and the employee handbook, keeping them compliant and easy to use.

- Track legislative changes, including the Employment Rights Act reforms, and lead their implementation.

description:

Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

As one of the first Lifecycle Value Managers in EMEA, you’ll help build Everpure™’s new post-sale value management function in the UK. • Identify expansion, Portworx® by Everpure™, and Evergreen//One migration opportunities, equipping AEs with qualified opportunities while owning the value conversation.
